edits.old: Concessionaire responsible for the design, construction, operation and maintenance of Metro Line 1, per the EIB Complaints Mechanism (2025). Its owners are not named in any document I opened, so no headquarters is given here.
edits.new: Concessionaire for Metro Line 1 under concession contract 163 of 2019 with Empresa Metro de Bogota, signed on 27 November 2019 and covering investment, financing, design, construction, supply, commissioning, operation and maintenance (bogota.gov.co, 2023). Bogota's city website said in 2023 that its shareholders are China Harbour Engineering Company Limited (85%) and Xi'an Rail Transportation Group Company Limited (15%); Empresa Metro de Bogota's ABC sheet gives the same split under the shareholder's former name, Xi'an Metro Company Limited, and its 2019 management report records the change of name.
